tools.name: execute_javascript
tools.description: [primary] Execute JavaScript in either the scene or editor context. Use context="scene" for live scene/runtime inspection and mutation, or context="editor" for Editor APIs, asset-db workflows, MCP orchestration, local filesystem access, and higher-level automation. Prefer this as the main flexible tool when many narrow tools would be noisy.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. May directly return a value, define run(env), or export a function.

args.description: Optional JSON object passed into the script.

safety_checks.description: Override the project default JavaScript safety checks for this call.

ok.description: Whether the tool call completed successfully.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this result.

execution.description: Script-only execution metadata; data retains its original return shape.
